seo.title: Dr. Menna Aboelata | General Dentist
seo.description: Portfolio of Dr. Menna Aboelata Salem, general dentist and dental intern at MSA University: education, clinical experience, dental photography and skills.

hero.headline: Dental graduate with
hero.lede: I'm Dr. Menna Aboelata Salem, a general dentist completing my internship year at MSA University. I'm keen to keep building hands-on skills and to give patients high-quality care.

about.heading: Menna Aboelata Salem
paragraphs: I graduated in dental surgery from MSA University and am now completing my internship year. My clinical experience covers restorative dentistry, endodontics, periodontics, oral surgery, prosthodontics and pediatric dentistry.
I have also worked as a clinical observer and dental assistant in two clinics, where I documented cases with dental photography.

details.text: Bachelor of Dental Surgery, MSA University. GPA 3.3.

experience.heading: Clinical experience so far
experience.intro: Two clinic roles in Tanta, plus experience in general anaesthesia cases.

items.title: Premium Dental Clinic
items.description: Clinical observer and dental assistant with Dr. Mohamed El-Sawaf. Observed procedures and cases, assisted the dentist and kept the clinical workflow running, documented cases with intraoral and extraoral photographs, and prepared case posts for social media.
items.label: 3 months

items.title: Luxury Dental Clinic
items.description: Clinical observer and dental assistant with Dr. Mostafa El-Masry. Helped with chairside preparation and procedures, built experience in patient communication and clinical team coordination, and saw patient assessment, diagnosis and treatment planning.
items.label: 3 months

items.title: General anaesthesia cases
items.description: Assisted the dentist during comprehensive dental treatment under general anaesthesia, working as part of a dental team and building teamwork and communication skills.
items.label: Assistant
